## Load Data

```{r}
#| label: packages-data

library(tidyverse)
library(moments)
library(boot)

data <- read_csv("data-train.csv")
```

## Transform Data

```{r}
#| label: transform

#making new variables for our summary stats

#mean = R_moment_1, C_moment_2 is variance, everything else is as commented
data <- data |>
  mutate(
    m1 = R_moment_1, m2 = R_moment_2, m3 = R_moment_3, m4 = R_moment_4,

    # central moments
    C_moment_2 = m2 - m1^2,                               # variance
    C_moment_3 = m3 - 3*m1*m2 + 2*m1^3,
    C_moment_4 = m4 - 4*m1*m3 + 6*m1^2*m2 - 3*m1^4,

    # standardized versions
    sd_R     = sqrt(C_moment_2),
    skewness = C_moment_3 / sd_R^3,
    kurtosis = C_moment_4 / sd_R^4,                       # raw kurtosis
    ex_kurt  = kurtosis - 3                               # excess kurtosis
  )

#using a categorical to address infinity
data <- data |>
  mutate(
    Fr = as.factor(Fr),
    Re = as.factor(Re)
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: eda

plot(data_train$St)
plot(log(data_train$St))

```

```{r}
#| label: train

#basic linear models for all
#mean
mean.fit <- glm(R_moment_1 ~ St + Re + Fr, family = gaussian, data = data)
#sd
sd.fit <- glm(sd_R ~ St + Re + Fr, family = gaussian, data = data)
#skewness
skewness.fit <- glm(skewness ~ St + Re + Fr, family = gaussian, data = data)
#kurtosis
kurtosis.fit <- glm(kurtosis ~ St + Re + Fr, family = gaussian, data = data)

#log St linear models
#mean
mean.fit.log <- glm(R_moment_1 ~ log(St) + Re + Fr, family = gaussian, data = data)
#sd
sd.fit.log <- glm(sd_R ~ log(St) + Re + Fr, family = gaussian, data = data)
#skewness
skewness.fit.log <- glm(skewness ~ log(St) + Re + Fr, family = gaussian, data = data)
#kurtosis
kurtosis.fit.log <- glm(kurtosis ~ log(St) + Re + Fr, family = gaussian, data = data)

#cv for mean fits
cv.err.mean <- cv.glm(data, mean.fit)
cv.err.mean.log <- cv.glm(data, mean.fit.log)

#cv for sd fits
cv.err.sd <- cv.glm(data, sd.fit)
cv.err.sd.log <- cv.glm(data, sd.fit.log)

#cv for skewness fits
cv.err.skewness <- cv.glm(data, skewness.fit)
cv.err.skewness.log <- cv.glm(data, skewness.fit.log)

#cv for kurtosis fits
cv.err.kurtosis <- cv.glm(data, kurtosis.fit)
cv.err.kurtosis.log <- cv.glm(data, kurtosis.fit.log)
```


```{r}
#| label: results

cv.err.mean$delta
cv.err.mean.log$delta

#cv for sd fits
cv.err.sd$delta
cv.err.sd.log$delta

#cv for skewness fits
cv.err.skewness$delta
cv.err.skewness.log$delta

#cv for kurtosis fits
cv.err.kurtosis$delta
cv.err.kurtosis.log$delta

```
